title: The hyperfinite II$_1$-factor is Ulam stable
summary: We prove Ulam stability of the hyperfinite II$_1$-factor with respect to the trace norm on the operator-norm unit ball. More precisely, every sufficiently additive, multiplicative, unital, $*$-preserving map from the hyperfinite II$_1$-factor-factor into a II$_1$-factor-factor von Neumann algebra is uniformly close, after passing to a small amplification of the target, to a genuine unital $*$-homomorphism.
